title: horkelia kingii
intro: Horkelia kingii, commonly known as King's crown or King's horkelia, is a flowering plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Horkelia kingii include wound healing and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of infections and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of Horkelia kingii include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
